findings.comment: The label "PFC mode" is misleading. In osu! and rhythm games generally, "PFC" stands for "Perfect Full Combo" (100% accuracy / all 300s). Sudden Death only fails on combo breaks, meaning players can still get 100s or 50s without failing; enabling this option does not enforce a PFC.
The combo failure logic duplicates the implementation already present in ModSuddenDeath.FailCondition.
